title: VP of Sales Hire Timing
description: When should a B2B SaaS founder hire their first VP of Sales — too early and they thrash, too late and you leave revenue on the table.

decision.prompt: Choose when to bring on a VP of Sales.

options.label: Hire now (< $500k ARR)
options.description: Bring in a VP early to build the sales motion from scratch. Risky if the playbook isn't proven yet.

options.label: Hire at $1M ARR
options.description: Wait until you have a repeatable sales motion, then hire someone to scale it.

options.label: Hire at $2M ARR
options.description: Founder-led sales all the way to $2M, then bring in professional sales leadership.

founder_can_sell.label: Founder Can Sell
founder_can_sell.description: Whether the founding team has the capacity and skill to close deals without dedicated sales staff.

avg_deal_size.label: Average Deal Size ($)
avg_deal_size.description: Average annual contract value per customer.

sales_cycle_days.label: Sales Cycle (days)
sales_cycle_days.description: Average number of days from first contact to closed-won.
